title: Recording Eyeglasses Order Decisions — Vision Plans Claims System Reference
content:
Cascade settles an **eyeglasses order** on a Vision Plans enrollment — the spectacle-lens line, the frame line or both of one claim — and records the decision. The decision fixes the remark on each line and the single amount the member pays for the whole order. After it is recorded, the claim's lines show these remarks and the amount on the member's claim history.

**When the member share is fixed.** The member share of an eyeglasses order is fixed only after no routine eye exam of the patient dated on or before the order still stands denied as not eligible. An eyeglasses order's member share is not worked out until no frame line of the patient on an out-of-network claim dated before the order still awaits its first decision.

**Scope.** This rule governs the settlement of eyeglasses orders only; contact lenses, exams and fittings remain under their own rules. For eyeglasses orders, benefit frequency and contacts-in-lieu are counted under this rule, from the latest paid or reimbursed service of the kind under the current enrollment, a reversal counting only when it reverses the one service on that latest date. The rules for exam visits, contact-lens orders, out-of-network claims settled on their glasses part or on their contact-lens part, and stand-alone contact-lens fittings count them the same way. Services paid by another carrier still do not count.

## `decide_eyeglasses_order_e7a7f40f`

**Capability.** `decide_eyeglasses_order_e7a7f40f` records Cascade's decision on the eyeglasses order — the spectacle lenses and frame of one claim — carrying the claim number. It decides at once the claim's open spectacle-lens and frame lines; open lines are lines carrying no remark yet or standing denied as not eligible. The claim's other lines are left as they are. Each line given a remark argument receives that denial remark. Every other line receives the paid remark of its channel: `PAID` at a participating location, `PAID_OON_REIMBURSEMENT` at a provider without a Cascade agreement. The amount is booked on the first line not denied, in the order exam, fitting, contact lenses, lenses, frame (the first line when every line is denied), with no separate amount on the other lines. Every line's decision date is set to today. After the call the claim's lines show these remarks and the amount on the member's claim history.

**How it is invoked.** It is an agent-side tool: the agent unlocks `decide_eyeglasses_order_e7a7f40f` and then calls it.

**Parameters**

- `claim_number` — the claim number of the claim, copied character for character from the vision claim lookup, with its letters, digits and hyphens unchanged.
- `member_paid` — the amount the member pays for the whole order, in USD, a non-negative number given to 2 decimal places (cents), rounded half up to the cent.
- `lenses_remark` — the denial remark recorded on the claim's spectacle-lens line, one of: `DENIED_FREQUENCY` when the line's benefit is not available again under the frequency rule; `DENIED_CONTACTS_IN_LIEU` when the line is left out because the other materials hold the benefit (contacts in lieu of glasses); `DENIED_NOT_COVERED` when the plan carries no benefit for the line; `DENIED_NOT_ELIGIBLE` when the enrollment does not cover the line's date of service; `DENIED_TIMELY_FILING` when the claim reached Cascade after the filing limit; an empty text when the claim carries no such line or the line is paid or reimbursed.
- `frame_remark` — the denial remark recorded on the claim's frame line, one of: `DENIED_FREQUENCY` when the line's benefit is not available again under the frequency rule; `DENIED_CONTACTS_IN_LIEU` when the line is left out because the other materials hold the benefit (contacts in lieu of glasses); `DENIED_NOT_COVERED` when the plan carries no benefit for the line; `DENIED_NOT_ELIGIBLE` when the enrollment does not cover the line's date of service; `DENIED_TIMELY_FILING` when the claim reached Cascade after the filing limit; an empty text when the claim carries no such line or the line is paid or reimbursed.

A remark argument left as an empty text leaves that line to receive the paid remark of its channel.

**Return.** A dictionary rendered as text means the claim is recorded. It carries `claim_number` (the claim recorded), `member_paid` (the amount booked, USD with 2 decimal places), `lines` (each recorded line's reference number mapped to the remark now recorded) and `adjudicated_date` (today's date, year-month-day). A text starting "No open claim line" means no open line carries that claim number.
